```python
SymbolicTensor(value: Any, dtype: np.dtype, shape: Tuple[Union[DimExpr, int], ...], location: Any = None)
```

Part of [`evoxc.core`](/api/evoxc/core/)

An SSA value inside a graph — no storage, graph semantics only.

## Attributes

- `value` · `Any` — The underlying `ir.Value` (duck-typed protocol: must expose
  an `id` attribute; `SymbolicTensor` must not import `ir`).

- `dtype` · `np.dtype` — The element dtype (normalized to `numpy.dtype`).

- `shape` · `Tuple[Union[DimExpr, int], ...]` — Tuple of `DimExpr`/`int` entries (`Dim` entries are
  accepted and should be resolved to `DimExpr` by callers);
  symbolic shape of the value.

- `location` · `Any` — Optional source location (duck-typed `ir.Location` or a
  string); used in error messages.

Deliberately NOT defined: `numpy`, `data_ptr`, `__dlpack__`,
`__array__` — a symbolic tensor must never be mistaken for concrete
data. `__bool__` raises `TraceError` (runtime control flow must
use `evoxc.cond`/`evoxc.while_loop`/`evoxc.scan`). Unhashable
(`__hash__ = None`): `__eq__` builds an IR `equal` op, not a Python
bool, so symbolic tensors cannot safely be dict keys.

## id

The SSA identity of this value (`value.id`).
